description: A serene, minimalist primary bedroom in an all-neutral warm-cream palette with Japanese-Scandinavian sensibility. The headboard wall is a triptych composition: a large central panel clad in smooth cream or greige upholstered fabric — arranged in a five-panel grid of tall vertical rectangles with subtle shadow-gap reveals — flanked on each side by tall vertical panels of natural light oak veneer. Within each oak panel, a continuous thin strip of warm ambient glow runs floor-to-ceiling in a recessed channel, emanating soft golden uplight and downlight without any visible fixture form. The ceiling is smooth warm cream plaster or paint. A very subtle recessed light effect warms the upper ceiling. Floor-to-ceiling cream linen drapery at the far right softens the wall transition. The bed is a wide, low-profile platform style with a thick upholstered cream-beige fabric headboard composed of three wide vertical segments and a matching platform base, dressed with crisp white cotton pillows, a warm cream duvet, and a grey textured throw blanket across the foot. Flanking the bed on each side, a sculptural solid wood mushroom-shaped side table in light blonde oak — a cylindrical pedestal base topped by a round disc tabletop — holds minimal styling on the left: a small stack of books and a natural woven basket. The floor is covered by a large cream or oatmeal toned loop-pile area rug. The entire palette is a tonal study in warm cream, beige, blonde oak, and white — absolutely zero color accent. Camera is at standing eye-level, centered symmetrically on the bed and headboard wall, using a normal lens. The composition is centered and perfectly symmetrical.
